raw: {"analysis":"Response JCT correctly serializes fraud team validation before any code is written, which is the safest approach for a non-idempotent payment system where the core risk is double-billing. It also provides more concrete guidance on defining 'definitely did not reach the processor' (TCP timeouts vs HTTP 5xx) and better CI cost control with explicit per-lane budgets. Response CBF has a solid structure and good operational detail (metrics, dashboards, force-open circuit breaker), but allows implementation to proceed in parallel with fraud validation, which is riskier given the ticket's emphasis on safety-first coordination.","verdict":"JCT"}
